The migration service, exposing apis for migration jobs operations, and
agent management.

## Overview

Most applications use the `*Client` types in this library:

- `MigrationServiceClient`: Service to handle EDW migrations.

## Quickstart

The following example demonstrates using `MigrationServiceClient`:

```swift
import Foundation
import GoogleBigQueryMigrationV2

func sample(parent: String, ) async throws {
  let client = try GoogleBigQueryMigrationV2.MigrationServiceClient()
  let items = client.listMigrationWorkflowsByItems(
    request: ListMigrationWorkflowsRequest()
  .with {
    $0.parent = "\(parent)"
  }
)
  for try await item in items {
    print("  \(item)")
  }
}
```

For the minimum supported Swift version and platform requirements, see the

## Installation

Add `swift-google-cloud-bigquery-migration-v2` as a package dependency:

```bash
swift package add-dependency https://github.com/googleapis/swift-google-cloud-bigquery-migration-v2.git --from 0.3.0
```

Then add `GoogleBigQueryMigrationV2` to your target's dependencies:

```bash
swift package add-target-dependency GoogleBigQueryMigrationV2 <target-name> --package swift-google-cloud-bigquery-migration-v2
```
